# Model Fitting Setup Validation

Make the estimand and fitted data explicit before comparing or accepting
models.

## Setup

Resolve the applicable choices:

- requested output: prediction, optimum location, response at the optimum,
  model metric, coefficient, p-value, class, or another quantity;
- response and predictor definitions, units, transformations, and category or
  event orientation;
- included row scope, controls, baselines, endpoints, missing values, and
  replicate handling;
- candidate models, formulas, fixed parameters, and fitting implementation;
- comparison metric and convention

# Galaxy UDT Templates And Troubleshooting

Read only the section needed for the current UDT.

## Minimal UDT

Replace the container placeholder with a pinned BioContainer found through one
bounded live BioContainers lookup. Use a bare tagged reference without
`docker://` or a digest.

```yaml
class: GalaxyUserTool
id: analysis-v1
name: Analysis
version: 0.1.0
container: quay.io/biocontainers/<package>:<pinned-tag>

shell_command: |
  set -eu
  selected-command \
    --input "$(inputs.input.path)" \
    --output result.tsv

inputs:
  - name: input
    type: data
    format: [tabular]

outputs:
  - name: result
    type: data
    format: tabular
    from_work_dir: result.tsv
```

keeps the script as one shell token:

```bash
SCRIPT_B64='BASE64_WITHOUT_NEWLINES'
python -c 'import base64, pathlib, sys; pathlib.Path("job.py").write_bytes(base64.b64decode(sys.argv[1]))' "$SCRIPT_B64"
python job.py "$(inputs.inpu

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)

out[["area_max"]] <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(out)), function(i) max(d[["Area"]][as.character(d[["StrainNumber"]])==as.character(out[["StrainNumber"]][i]) & d[["Ratio"]]==out[["Ratio"]][i]]), numeric(1))
write.table(out, file="combination_audit.tsv", sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE)

representation.name: Swarm R polynomial and natural spline comparison
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
cat > job.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
d <- read.csv(args[1], stringsAsFactors=FALSE, check.names=FALSE)
required <- c("StrainNumber","Ratio","Area")
if (!all(required %in% names(d))) stop("Missing required columns")
if (anyNA(d[required])) stop("Missing model fields")
parts <- strsplit(d[["Ratio"]], ":", fixed=TRUE)
if (any(lengths(parts) != 2L)) stop("Invalid ratio encoding")
num <- vapply(parts, function(z) as.numeric(z[1]), numeric(1))
den <- vapply(parts, function(z) as.numeric(z[2]), numeric(1))
if (any(!is.finite(num)) || any(!is.finite(den)) || any(num + den <= 0)) stop("Invalid ratio values")
d[["p287"]] <- num/(num+den)
mix <- d[as.character(d[["StrainNumber"]]) == "287_98", c("Area","p287")]
names(mix) <- c("area","p")
if (nrow(mix) != 36L) stop("Unexpected mixture row count")
if (length(unique(mix[["p"]])) != 12L) stop("Unexpected mixture frequency count")
pure287 <- d[as.character(d[["StrainNumber"]]) == "287", "Area", drop=TRUE]
pure98 <- d[as.character(d[["StrainNumber"]]) == "98", "Area", drop=TRUE]
if (length(pure287) != 3L || length(pure98) != 3L) stop("Unexpected pure endpoint counts")
complete <- rbind(mix, data.frame(area=pure98,p=0), data.frame(area=pure287,p=1))

find_optimum <- function(fit, lo, hi) {
  grid <- seq(lo, hi, length.out=10001L)
  yg <- as.numeric(predict(fit, newdata=data.frame(p=grid)))
  local <- which(yg[2:(length(yg)-1L)] >= yg[1:(length(yg)-2L)] &
                 yg[2:(length(yg)-1L)] >= yg[3:length(yg)]) + 1L
  cand_p <- c(lo, hi)
  for (i in local) {
    left <- grid[max(1L, i-1L)]
    right <- grid[min(length(grid), i+1L)]
    z <- optimize(function(x) as.numeric(predict(fit,newdata=data.frame(p=x))),
                  interval=c(left,right), maximum=TRUE, tol=1e-12)
    cand_p <- c(cand_p, z[["maximum"]])
  }
  cand_y <- vapply(cand_p, function(x) as.numeric(predict(fit,newdata=data.frame(p=x))), numeric(1))
  j <- which.max(cand_y)
  c(optimal_p=cand_p[j], predicted_max=cand_y[j])
}

fit_scope <- function(dat, scope) {
  fits <- list(
    quadratic=lm(area ~ p + I(p^2), data=dat),
    cubic=lm(area ~ p + I(p^2) + I(p^3), data=dat),
    natural_spline_df4=lm(area ~ splines::ns(p, df=4), data=dat)
  )
  nobs_vec <- vapply(fits, nobs, numeric(1))
  if (length(unique(nobs_vec)) != 1L || nobs_vec[1] != nrow(dat)) stop("Candidate models used different rows")
  aics <- vapply(fits, AIC, numeric(1))
  best <- names(fits)[which.min(aics)]
  opts <- lapply(fits, find_optimum, lo=min(dat[["p"]]), hi=max(dat[["p"]]))
  data.frame(
    scope=scope,
    model=names(fits),
    n=as.integer(nobs_vec),
    parameter_count=vapply(fits,function(x) as.integer(attr(logLik(x),"df")),integer(1)),
    aic=as.numeric(aics),
    optimal_p=vapply(opts,function(x)x[["optimal_p"]],numeric(1)),
    predicted_max=vapply(opts,function(x)x[["predicted_max"]],numeric(1)),
    best_by_min_aic=names(fits)==best,
    domain_min=min(dat[["p"]]),
    domain_max=max(dat[["p"]]),
    stringsAsFactors=FALSE
  )
}

res <- rbind(fit_scope(mix,"mixtures_only"),fit_scope(complete,"mixtures_plus_pure_endpoints"))
write.table(res,file="model_results.tsv",sep="\t",quote=FALSE,row.names=FALSE,digits=15)
chosen <- res[res[["scope"]]=="mixtures_only" & res[["best_by_min_aic"]],]
if (nrow(chosen) != 1L) stop("Best model selection failed")
writeLines(format(round(chosen[["predicted_max"]],6),scientific=FALSE,trim=TRUE,nsmall=0),con="answer.txt")
RSCRIPT
Rscript job.R "$(inputs.input.path)"

fit_scope <- function(dat, scope) {
  fits <- list(
    quadratic=lm(area ~ p + I(p^2), data=dat),
    cubic=lm(area ~ p + I(p^2) + I(p^3), data=dat),
    natural_spline_df4=lm(area ~ splines::ns(p, df=4), data=dat)
  )
  nobs_vec <- vapply(fits, nobs, numeric(1))
  if (length(unique(nobs_vec)) != 1L || nobs_vec[1] != nrow(dat)) stop("Candidate models used different rows")
  aics <- vapply(fits, AIC, numeric(1))
  best <- names(fits)[which.min(aics)]
  opts <- lapply(fits, find_optimum, lo=min(dat[["p"]]), hi=max(dat[["p"]]))
  data.frame(
    scope=scope,
    model=names(fits),
    n=as.integer(nobs_vec),
    parameter_count=vapply(fits,function(x) as.integer(attr(logLik(x),"df")),integer(1)),
    aic=as.numeric(aics),
    optimal_p=vapply(opts,function(x)x[["optimal_p"]],numeric(1)),
    predicted_max=vapply(opts,function(x)x[["predicted_max"]],numeric(1)),
    best_by_min_aic=names(fits)==best,
    domain_min=min(dat[["p"]]),
    domain_max=max(dat[["p"]]),
    stringsAsFactors=FALSE
  )
}

res <- rbind(fit_scope(mix,"mixtures_only"),fit_scope(complete,"mixtures_plus_pure_endpoints"))
write.table(res,file="model_results.tsv",sep="\t",quote=FALSE,row.names=FALSE)
chosen <- res[res[["scope"]]=="mixtures_only" & res[["best_by_min_aic"]],]
if (nrow(chosen) != 1L) stop("Best model selection failed")
writeLines(format(round(chosen[["predicted_max"]],6),scientific=FALSE,trim=TRUE,nsmall=0),con="answer.txt")
